name: Guadalupe (Santander, Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and blue, overlaid by a white diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Guadalupe, a municipality in the department of Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
